'''Genesian Customs''' was an organization that deal with customs inspections in the [[Genesia system/Legends|Genesia system]]. Due to the highly corrupt nature of bureaucratic organizations in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], Genesian Customs could often be bribed.

{{RPGseed}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a Genesian Customs [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was bribed by an industrial corporation on [[Genesia]] to intercept a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hired by their competitor. The ship was transporting a new chemical, and the corporation directed the officer to declare the cargo unsafe to transport and fire it into the system's [[Genesia (star)|star]].
